channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD extends decline to near $66.50 as bond yields rise further
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) extends its decline to near $66.50 during the late Asian trading session on Monday, the lowest level seen in over two months.

item.title: Forex Today: Markets turn risk-averse as Iran and Israel exchange strikes
item.description: Here is what you need to know on Monday, June 8:

item.title: $4,300: Gold languishes near March low as inflation fears lift Fed rate hike bets
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) drops to its lowest level since March 23 during the Asian session on Monday and now seems to have found acceptance below a technically significant 200-day Simple Moving Average (SMA).

item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Rises toward 1.1550 after rebounding from channel bottom
item.description: EUR/USD rebounds after registering 0.75% losses in the previous day, trading around 1.1530 during the Asian hours on Monday. The daily chart technical analysis indicates an ongoing bearish bias as the pair is positioned near the lower boundary of the descending channel pattern.

item.title: NZD/USD Price Forecast: Recovers from two-month low, retakes 0.5800 amid bearish setup
item.description: The NZD/USD pair stages a modest recovery following an Asian session dip to the 0.5780 region, or a two-month low, as the US Dollar (USD) enters a bullish consolidation phase on Monday.

item.title: British Pound holds losses below 1.3350 amid Middle East turmoil
item.description: The GBP/USD pair trades with mild losses around 1.3340 during the European trading hours on Monday. Ongoing tensions in the Middle East and rising bets of a US interest rate hike provide some support to the US Dollar (USD) against the British Pound (GBP).

item.title: Indian Rupee declines due to rising hawkish Fed bets, renewed Middle East war
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) starts the week on a negative note against the US Dollar (USD), with the USD/INR pair rising to near 95.30.

item.title: Iran's ambassador to Moscow: the Strait of Hormuz will be open but with transit fees
item.description: Iran's ambassador to Moscow, Kazem Jalali, said that the Strait of Hormuz will be open but under new conditions to be set by Iran and Oman, including a transit fee, Reuters reported on Monday.

item.title: WTI Price Forecast: Sticks to gains near $92.00; 200-SMA on H4 holds the key for bulls
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US Crude Oil price – gains strong positive traction at the start of a new week as renewed hostilities in the Gulf dampen hopes for a deal to end a three-month-old war.

item.title: India Gold price today: Gold falls, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices fell in India on Monday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: Indonesian Rupiah hits historic lows as forex reserves plunge
item.description: USD/IDR extends its gains for the fifth successive day, trading around 18,200 after hitting an all-time high of 18,210 during the Asian hours on Monday.

item.title: AUD/JPY Price Forecast: Strengthens above 113.00, hawkish RBA supports uptrend above 100-day SMA
item.description: The AUD/JPY cross trades in positive territory around 113.05 during the early European trading hours on Monday. A hawkish stance from the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) underpins the Australian Dollar (AUD) against the Japanese Yen (JPY).

item.title: Swiss Franc declines as safe-haven demand supports US Dollar
item.description: USD/CHF extends its gains for the second successive day, trading around 0.7970 during the Asian hours on Monday.

item.title: Asian stock markets plunge due to US tech rally halt, KOSPI triggers circuit breaker
item.description: Asian stock markets face a massive sell-off at the start of the week due to multiple tailwinds.

item.title: Israeli military intercepts missile launched from Yemen
item.description: During the Asian trade on Monday, the Israeli military stated a missile had been launched from Yemen towards Israeli territory, which has been intercepted by its aerial defense systems, The Guardian reported. Air raid sirens sound in Tel Aviv, following the attack from Yemen.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Trades near 185.00 after rebounding from triangle bottom
item.description: EUR/JPY gains ground after registering over 0.5% in the previous day, trading around 184.90 during the Asian hours on Monday.

item.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Flat lines around mid-0.7000s; seems vulnerable below 100-day SMA
item.description: The AUD/USD pair attracts some buyers after touching a nearly two-month low, around the 0.7025-0.7020 area during the Asian session on Monday, though it lacks follow-through.

item.title: United States Dollar Index holds steady near 100.00 on Middle East tensions, rising Fed hike bets
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), an index of the value of the US Dollar (USD) measured against a basket of six world currencies, currently trades near 100.10 during the Asian trading hours on Monday.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD falls to near $67.50 as oil, Fed hike fears weigh
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) remains subdued for the second successive day, trading around $67.70 per troy ounce during the Asian hours on Monday. The non-yielding white metal declines as renewed tensions in the Middle East drive oil prices higher and fuel concerns about inflation and interest rates.

item.title: Canadian Dollar slides to fresh low since late March vs USD despite rallying Oil prices
item.description: The USD/CAD pair touched a fresh high since late March during the Asian session on Monday and looks to build on the strength further beyond mid-1.3900s.

item.title: Israeli Air Force strikes military targets in western and central Iran following missile attacks
item.description: The Israel Defense Forces (IDF) said that it struck military targets in western and central Iran, hours after Iran fired a salvo of missiles at northern Israel, the BBC reported on Monday.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar rebounds to near 0.5800 amid easing risk aversion
item.description: NZD/USD gains ground after registering over 1% losses in the previous day, trading around 0.5810 during the Asian hours on Monday. The pair appreciates as the US Dollar (USD) edges lower on easing risk aversion after US President Donald Trump criticized Israel's strikes on Beirut.

item.title: Euro edges higher above 1.1500 on ECB hike bets, traders eye on Middle East tensions
item.description: The EUR/USD pair gains momentum to around 1.1535 during the early Asian trading hours on Monday. Nonetheless, persistent geopolitical tension might cap the upside for the Euro (EUR) against the US dollar (USD).

item.title: PBOC sets USD/CNY reference rate at 6.8198 vs. 6.8157 previous
item.description: On Monday, the People’s Bank of China (PBOC) sets the USD/CNY central rate for the trading session ahead at 6.8198 compared to Friday's fix of 6.8157.

item.title: British Pound recovers slightly from three-week low as USD bulls pause for a breather
item.description: The GBP/USD pair recovers slightly from a three-week low, touched during the Asian session on Monday, and climbs closer to mid-1.3300s in the last hour.

item.title: WTI holds gains near $90.50 as Iran launches missiles toward Israel
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) oil price edges lower after opening at a bullish gap, remaining in the positive territory and trading around $90.50 per barrel during the Asian hours on Monday.

item.title: OPEC+ agrees fourth oil output quota hike in July
item.description: The Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries and its allies (OPEC+) agreed on Sunday to increase production by 188,000 barrels per day (bpd) in July despite the continued closure of the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Japanese Yen holds below 160.00 following Q1 GDP data
item.description: USD/JPY moves little after registering modest gains in the previous day, trading around 160.30 during the Asian hours on Monday. With the currency pair holding firm above the critical 160.00 threshold, market participants remain highly alert to potential government intervention.

item.title: Gold rebounds to near $4,350 despite Middle East tensions
item.description: Gold price (XAU/USD) recovers some lost ground to around $4,345 during the early Asian session on Monday.

item.title: Australian Dollar softens as Middle East tensions, stronger jobs report boost US Dollar
item.description: The AUD/USD pair remains under selling pressure near 0.7035 during the early Asian session on Monday. The Australian Dollar (AUD) extends the decline against the US Dollar (USD) amid escalating tensions in the Middle East and stronger-than-expected US economic data.
